description: Average the season-to-date points of driver standings records whose points are at least 1.0, counting records at exactly 1.0.

c.request: Split driver standings records by their season-to-date championship points total (`driverStandings.points`), using 1.0 points as the dividing line, and keep only the records on the higher side. What is the single overall average of that points total across the kept records (ignoring missing values, unrounded)? Average the season-to-date points of driver standings records whose points are at least 1.0, counting records at exactly 1.0.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0

b.request: Average the season-to-date championship points (`driverStandings.points`) over only those driver standings records with points greater than or equal to 1.0 (including records at exactly 1.0), ignoring NULLs, as one overall unrounded average.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0
b.raw: Average the season-to-date championship points (`driverStandings.points`) over only those driver standings records with points greater than or equal to 1.0 (including records at exactly 1.0), ignoring NULLs, as one overall unrounded average.

d.request: Compute the average of `driverStandings.points` over only those driver standings records whose season-to-date points total is at least 1.0 (including records at exactly 1.0), ignoring NULLs, as a single unrounded overall value.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0

a.request: Looking only at driver standings records whose season-to-date championship points total (`driverStandings.points`) is at least 1.0, what is the single overall average of that points total across those records (ignoring missing values, unrounded)?
a.sql: SELECT AVG(points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0
